(3) DECISION LOGIC: Match request context (Actor, Source, Role, Context, Validity) against Authority Object. Result: ALLOW | DENY. (7) PLACEMENT: Guard invoked IMMEDIATELY after request received, BEFORE any processing, BEFORE any database access, BEFORE append_event or any state change. IMPLEMENTATION PATTERN: @guard_required_for_route(route_name, action, resource) decorator or inline guard_check() call at top of route handler. GUARD OUTPUT: Success path logs (actor, action, resource, timestamp). Denial path logs (actor, action, resource, denial_reason, timestamp). Authority Object Format: {route, action, resource, permitted_actors: [], permitted_sources: [], required_role: [], validity: {start, end}, context_requirements: {}}.
